generation.method: Deterministic hand-authored fictional records created from an original teaching specification; no publication, bibliographic database export, fitted distribution, scraped value, model output, benchmark record, real identifier, or competing-course asset was used.

rights.authorship_assertion: The project authors created every byte of the fixture data and metadata except the names of open formats and the linked CC0 legal instrument.
rights.course_code_and_copy: Not covered by this data dedication; governed by the repository and source-specific terms.

datasheet.purpose: A small offline corpus for protocol locking, transparent search logging, deduplication, screening, evidence hierarchy, claim-source ledgers, page/table extraction, linked correction handling, citation verification, RAG-as-locator boundaries, quantitative and qualitative boundary setting, reproducibility, uncertainty, and AI disclosure.
datasheet.unit_of_observation: One fictional bibliographic-style record with embedded fictional method, result, limitation, and locator text; local REC identifiers do not denote publications.
datasheet.composition: Eleven fictional records returned by two overlapping fictional search receipts, including one duplicate carrier, one correction, qualitative and quantitative designs, clear exclusions, and three citation-audit cases.
datasheet.identifier_policy: No DOI, PMID, ISBN, trial registration, repository handle, ORCID, journal issue, or real database accession is asserted.
datasheet.result_generation: All participant counts, means, standard deviations, intervals, quotations, page locators, screening hints, and correction values were manually selected for traceable exercises and do not arise from a population, study, publication, model, or causal process.
datasheet.maintenance: Immutable. Any byte change requires a new fixture version, new hash, and new notice/provenance version.

known_artificialities: Search interfaces, queries, hit counts, records, studies, results, pages, tables, quotations, and correction relationships are all authored fiction.
Screening hints provide a deterministic self-check and are not duplicate independent-review decisions.
The corpus deliberately contains obvious boundary cases and cannot approximate the ambiguity or coverage of a real evidence base.
The numeric examples are internally readable but have no sampling distribution, target population, external validity, or substantive meaning.
non_claims: No record is a publication, source, citation, study registration, dataset, or evidence item and none may be cited as one.
No claim about real learners, educators, institutions, systems, interventions, outcomes, mechanisms, experiences, disparities, or effectiveness.

No claim of comprehensive retrieval, independent screening, representativeness, causal identification, statistical inference, evidence certainty, reproducibility of a real study, or fitness for policy.
No authorisation to pool the values, grade the toy corpus as real evidence, or present any authored result as factual.
